ja: ガンダムシリーズ最新作『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、チュアチュリー・パンランチがFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
• 豊富な表情はタンポ印刷済みパーツ１種と、水転写式デカール用パーツ２種で再現。チュチュのあふれる感情を演出できるよう、細部まで徹底追求。
• チュチュの特徴的な髪型はパーツ構成を考慮し、立体的に造形。
• 制服の色分けはパーツ分割、肩や胸元の装飾は付属シールで表現。
• 専用のボディパーツに差し替えることで“しゃがみ”“座り”などそれぞれ自然な姿勢でディスプレイできる。
• ハンドパーツは全10種が付属。繊細な指先まで演出。
• 工具や、スマホ型生徒手帳が付属し、劇中イメージを楽しめる。
• 付属の台座は２種類のジョイントで姿勢を保持。可動範囲を大きく確保した首回りで自然なポーズでのディスプレイが可能。
en: From the latest Gundam series "Mobile Suit Gundam Witch of Mercury", Chuchu Lee Pan Lunch is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

• The rich expressions are reproduced with one type of tampo-printed part and two types of water transfer decal parts. We have paid close attention to every detail to bring out the full emotion of the tutu.
• Tutu's distinctive hairstyle is sculpted three-dimensionally, taking into account the composition of her parts.
• The color coding of the uniform is divided into parts, and the decorations on the shoulders and chest are expressed with the included seals.
• By replacing the body parts with special body parts, you can display it in a natural posture such as "squatting" or "sitting".
• A total of 10 types of hand parts are included. Directions down to the delicate fingertips.
• Comes with tools and a smartphone-type student notebook, allowing you to enjoy images from the play.
• The included pedestal maintains its posture with two types of joints. The neck has a wide range of motion, allowing for display in natural poses.
